gen-luckiest-guy-gf-radio-canada-big: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy pours its ink in one width, while Radio Canada Big plays the plain sans underneath. Those clear-ended terminals give the shouting somewhere to rest.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-saira: Clean and see-through in each s, the body text sits under the loud cheer of Luckiest Guy. Saira's rounded letters stretch high toward the top line, a lean foil to that poured ink.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-savate: Savate opens its jaws on every curve, with a slight worn-charcoal pressure shadow in its hairlines. But Luckiest Guy is built to shout, while Savate is built to be read.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Poured ink meets open, friendly letterforms. Luckiest Guy does the shouting with its uniform-thickness bars, while Schibsted Grotesk handles the actual reading with big open e and a shapes.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-pathway-extreme: Grandstander draws plain constant-width lines and keeps its letters held open, which is where its bold, expressive streak comes from. Pathway Extreme counters with clear openings and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, built for steady reading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in every curve, like a rope's open bight. And Eater, dark and aggressive, spreads wide gaps between its letters, so menace sits above and ease below.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-jp: Tile-like letters with wide grout lines set the tone in Audiowide, then Noto Sans JP sweeps open beneath. And Noto Sans JP can be sized down a notch thanks to its very large x-height.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sono: Sono sets its lowercase with wide spacing, each a left ajar. The standout is how Oxanium's distinctive, commanding, uninterrupted monoline strokes sit against Sono's easygoing, widely spaced lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-stack-sans-notch: Bold letters stride widely apart in Revalia, its g left open at the bottom. Stack Sans Notch reads like wire gliding under the eye, with clean open curves and rod-straight bars, page after page.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text keeps a marker-like line with curve endings held well apart. Stack Sans Text then steps aside while Snowburst One, a stencil with wide bridges, earns its keep big and short.
